source_en: Corner shop. Mum needed bread.
Playing with Dima. He went home.
Checking if school gates were open.
Going to school. Lessons at eight.
Home to Dad. He's making dinner.
Back from my factory shift.
Sorry, I have the form somewhere, I swear I had it.
It's a lot quieter outside. I keep telling myself it's fine. Is it?
Thank you. Sorry for the wait, Officer. Sorry.
I'm not infected. I've been so careful. So incredibly careful.
Please don't tell my parents. They'll just worry more. Please.
I wasn't ready... I still had things... I still had things...
I want my mom... I just... I want my mom...
Where are you coming from?
The corner shop. Mum needed bread. I had the coupons the whole time.
From school. Lessons finished early today, so the teacher let us go.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
My hands shake sometimes. Mum says it's the cold. No fever, I checked.
No. My hands are totally still, look. I never get nervous about anything.
Sorry, is this the right form? I filled it out twice just in case.
My hands keep shaking. It is probably just the cold, right?
